parties.note: Founded 25 March 2004 as a movement and transformed into a party on 27 January 2009. Chairs: Artur Mikvabia from its creation; Daur Tarba from 27 January 2009 to 1 October 2015 (not recorded as a person here); Aleksei Tania acting; Sergei Shamba from 27 January 2016. Wikipedia lists social conservatism and republicanism (centre-right). Party of President Bagapsh.

name.en: Forum for the National Unity of Abkhazia

parties.note: Founded 8 February 2005 by supporters of Raul Khajimba from the October 2004 election; a socio-political movement from 10 October 2005 (co-chairs Avtandil Gartskia, Vitali Gabnia and Daur Arshba) and a party from 6 March 2008 (co-chairs Daur Arshba and Astamur Tania). Khajimba was elected sole chairman on 12 May 2010; Daur Arshba succeeded him on 31 March 2015. Wikipedia lists nationalism; national_conservative is a gameplay classification.

source.title: Wikipedia: Forum for the National Unity of Abkhazia

parties.note: Founded 2001 and re-established on 27 July 2016 by Leonid Lakerbaia (co-chairman with Akhra Kvekveskiri). Listed as President Ankvab's party in 2011. Wikipedia lists Abkhaz nationalism and russophilia.

parties.note: Founded 31 March 1999 as a veterans' association, a political association from 2002 and a party from 27 June 2013. It backed Sergei Bagapsh in 2004 and Aslan Bzhania in 2014; its leaders have included Sergei Shamba. The infobox names Alexey Tsugba as leader (not recorded as a person). Wikipedia lists Abkhazian nationalism and russophilia.

name.en: Party for the Economic Development of Abkhazia

parties.note: Founded 26 September 2007; chaired by Beslan Butba. Wikipedia lists social liberalism (centre). Nominated Sergei Shamba in 2011.
